text.en: Before the last train leaves, you find a letter in the empty station. It bears your name, but tomorrow's postmark.
text.zh-Hans: 末班车离站前，你在空荡的候车室捡到一封信。信封上写着你的名字，邮戳却是明天。

text.en: The letter says: Don't let the old station's lamp go out. Outside, a familiar figure walks away. You also hear the stationmaster calling your name.
text.zh-Hans: 信里写着：别让旧站的灯熄灭。窗外，一个熟悉的背影正在离开，你也听见站长喊你的名字。

text.en: The conductor recognizes the handwriting: the sender comes here every night. The stationmaster keeps his messages, and the man is just outside now.
text.zh-Hans: 列车员认出信封上的字迹，说写信的人每晚都来。站长保管着他的留言，那人此刻就在窗外。

text.en: You catch up at the old station's door. The man is handing his keys to the caretaker. Seeing the envelope, he stops. 'Have you finally decided to come?'
text.zh-Hans: 你追到旧站门口，那人正把钥匙交给管理员。看见信封，他停下脚步：你终于愿意来了吗？

text.en: The stationmaster brings out a stack of unsent letters. The top one reads: If you don't come tonight, I'll take the last train somewhere far away.
text.zh-Hans: 站长拿出一叠未寄出的信。最上面一封写着：如果今晚等不到你，我就搭末班车去远方。

text.en: The old lamp lights up, and your friend turns back. The train is still waiting. 'Stay and talk tonight, or write what we never said for tomorrow?'
text.zh-Hans: 旧灯亮起，朋友回过头来。列车还在等，他问你：今晚留下聊聊，还是把没说的话写给明天？

text.en: As your friend walks toward the train, he hands you a blank postcard. 'Write what you want to say for tomorrow.' You could also invite him back to sit at the station.
text.zh-Hans: 朋友走向列车，临行前递来一张空白明信片：把想说的话写给明天吧。你也可以邀他回旧站坐坐。

text.en: You finish reading those letters together in the old station. Smiling, your friend admits he stamped tomorrow's date by mistake. Luckily, your reunion wasn't another day late.
text.zh-Hans: 你们在旧站读完了那些信。朋友笑着承认，明天的邮戳是他盖错的。幸好重逢没有再迟一天。

text.en: You write a promise to meet on the letter's date: tomorrow. Before boarding, your friend smiles. 'The postmark was a mistake, but we mustn't miss tomorrow's meeting.'
text.zh-Hans: 你按信上明天的日期写下见面约定。朋友登车前笑了：邮戳虽然盖错，明天的约定可不能再错过。

summary.en: A letter stamped tomorrow holds back tonight's last train.
summary.zh-Hans: 一封盖着明天邮戳的信，留住了今晚的末班车。
